scope: Four active candidate campaigns; no task or result changes

native_timestamp_intervals.interpretation: Tool-return to assistant-response timestamps include provider computation, request/network latency and retries; they do not measure pure model computation. First/last unpaired intervals are omitted.

preceding_hour_slot_occupancy.method: Merge all four resource histories by timestamp, carrying forward each campaign's active_trials.

scheduler.finding: A temporarily held cell currently participates in the global minimum and can block all later rounds. No existing config field bypasses it without changing counts or targets.

limitations: Resource samples are a short snapshot and do not guarantee capacity during simultaneous compilation peaks.
Per-campaign admission_wait_reason is the latest waiter, not an aggregate utilization metric; image-held waiters can overwrite other wait reasons.
Diskcache's stale local resource timestamp is explained by the pre-admission round wait; its process remains alive.
